🪙 Ripple CTO Says Senate Blocked CLARITY Act to Shield Bank Profits

Ripple's CTO Emeritus isn't mincing words: he claims the US Senate stalled the CLARITY Act because clearer crypto rules could threaten bank earnings. 🏦

In his view, the pushback wasn't really about consumer protection, it was about the bottom line. Clear rules for digital assets could open the door to more competition, and that's something legacy finance is in no hurry to welcome.

Why does it matter? The CLARITY Act is one of the pieces of legislation the crypto industry has been watching closely, since market structure questions have kept builders in a gray zone for years. 🔥

If Schwartz is right, the holdup on crypto clarity has more to do with protecting existing revenue streams than with fixing the rules. Either way, the debate over who writes the rules for digital assets is still wide open.
